name: pk-cli-connector
description: Deploy-your-own Cloudflare Worker that serves piekstra-family CLI tools to claude.ai as a remote MCP connector (spike).

OWNER_PASSPHRASE.description: A long random passphrase (20+ characters, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 24`). You type it on this connector's approval page when you connect Claude; nobody without it can connect.

CBASE_CDP_KEY.description: Your Coinbase CDP API key JSON file, pasted whole. Create a read-only ECDSA key at https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com.
